commands.description: Use the actual filtered or filtered-selected grid stocks as the next universe, retaining prior metric stages. Does not execute; configure next rules without universe, then run.

commands.description: Refresh this account's cloud-saved screener metadata. Does not load or run.

Open a persisted result snapshot in the visible scanner. Does not rerun, consume allowance or change the current draft/universe. Use returned runId with getResults.
Copy the currently opened historical scan's rules and original stocks into the visible draft. No execution; starts an independent comparison on next run.
Delete only this account's immutable scan snapshot, not saved rules. Requires real sign-in, cloud-write grant and retry key.
Load saved rules into the visible UI without running; retain the currently selected universe.
Persist visible rules to this account's cloud storage. Requires real sign-in, cloud-write grant and retry key. Updates need id and etag; omitted id creates a copy.
Delete a cloud-saved screener at its current etag. Requires cloud-write grant and retry key; leaves the visible draft intact.
Open Historical Patterns and read the visible draft/revisions, chart ticker, analysis controls and job state. Does not fetch candles.

Close Historical Patterns and cancel pending study work. Applied results remain in this account's mounted workspace.

commands.description: Discover simulation-only order, accounting, Python signal and causality limits. No broker execution.
Search/page the three active local backtest/paper runs. Larger saved history is available through libraryList.
Search/page IndexedDB saved snapshots: max 100 runs / 100 MB per account. No source/candles. Active local workspace stays synchronous and limited to three runs.

params.scope: Optional all|backtest|paper. Paper includes replay and forward; filters before pagination. Storage usage remains account-wide.

commands.description: Save a stopped active run into larger local IndexedDB history. No silent eviction or cloud writes.

params.expectedLibraryRevision: 0 for new copy; current saved revision for replacement.

Restore one saved snapshot to a free active slot. Never overwrites active work or starts execution; running sessions restore paused.
Explicitly remove a saved snapshot only; active run and cloud layout are untouched.
Edit a saved snapshot's display name, notes and tags only. Immutable run evidence, active work and cloud layout are unchanged.
Read one locally saved snapshot's full payload, summary and display metadata so it can be backed up to the cloud or exported to a file. Active work, chart and cloud layout are unchanged.

Import a run payload from a cloud backup or exported file as a NEW local saved snapshot, so saved history survives a browser change. Never overwrites active work; a run already saved on this device is rejected. Requires the local indicator grant and retry key.

params.run: Full saved run payload (as returned by libraryExport).
params.summary: Saved run summary projection from libraryExport.
params.detail: Optional display metadata {name?:max100,notes?:max2000,tags?:up to10 strings max30}.

commands.description: Compare 2-4 same-sample saved snapshots. Metrics/assumptions are byte-bounded; follow nextOffset until null.

params.limit: 1-4, default4; response byte budget may return fewer.

commands.description: Compatibility alias for backtesting.optimize. Run bounded Python or Pine sweep/holdout/rolling walk-forward on a completed run's frozen source/candles. Pine uses actual fills, unchanged execution settings and captured request history only; no Python runtime or new fetches. Poll get section optimization; cancel with cancel. Every segment starts flat; selection uses the chosen training-only objective and constraints. Source lookahead remains unverified.

params.runId: Completed active backtest. Legacy Pine runs without authoritative fills/input metadata/frozen request history must be rerun first.
params.grid: Up to 4 Python parameter keys or declared Pine input variable IDs with value arrays; Cartesian max12. Pine values must satisfy declared types, bounds and options; not strategy execution-setting overrides.
params.folds: Walk-forward 1-5. Total max72 evaluations /1000 sequential prefix callbacks.
params.objective: Optional netPnl (highest, default) or maxDrawdown (lowest); training-only; ties grid order. P&L includes open mark-to-market.
params.minCompletedPositions: Optional integer >=0 default0. Fully completed positions (Pine entry lots), not exit legs; checked on training only.
params.maxDrawdown: Optional nonnegative maximum training drawdown in account currency/units, NOT percent.

commands.description: Read saved options, effective preview options, preview owner/ID/validity, active date selection and range handle IDs. Never executes a strategy.

Save account-local chart appearance/date selection, or preview/apply/cancel appearance edits without strategy execution. Preview does not persist; competing settings owners are refused. Runtime disposal clears agent previews; cancellation after a save is not rollback.

params.options: Partial {visible,scope:all|selected,markers,labels:none|selected|all,connections,riskLevels,openPosition,replayCutoff,paperClosedTrades,paperActivePosition,textClosedSide|Price|Pnl|Reason,textActiveSide|Price|Pnl (which label lines show),styles,drawing,scriptPlots,scriptDrawings}. scriptPlots maps keys from get.chartProjection.pineVisuals.plots to boolean visibility (512 saved keys maximum; each key at most 512 characters). scriptDrawings toggles Pine drawings, effects and tables; trade labels remain independent. Toggles boolean; replayCutoff defaults false and controls the line and timestamp together. Styles maps profit|loss|selected|stop|target|entry|cutoff to partial {color,width:1-4,style:0(solid)|1(dotted)|2(dashed),visible}. Drawing defaults are in capabilities.chartOptions.drawing: arrowMode compact|adjustable; arrowHeight8-300, arrowMargin0-100, labelGap0-200 (% candle range); arrowWidth/fillMarkWidth1-6px; fontSize/positionFontSize/pathFontSize8-24px; leaderWidth1-4px, leaderStyle0-2, leaderColor/pathTextColor auto or native color, pathBold/pathItalic boolean; fillMarkBars1-10 candles; fillMarkStyle0-2; fillMarks/bold/italic boolean; cutoffTransparency integer0-100 (0 opaque,100 line hidden; timestamp unaffected); buy/sell arrow/text/fill colors, profit/loss text colors, position/quantity backgrounds, quantityTextColor, cutoffLabelTextColor and cutoffLabelBackground accept auto or hex/rgb/rgba. Cutoff line color is styles.cutoff.color; timestamp colors are independent. Nested patches merge; appearance never changes execution or ledger data.
params.range: Optional {from,to} epoch ms inclusive, visible to seed loaded visible closed candles, or null to clear.
params.action: Optional save (default)|preview|apply|cancel. Preview replaces this owner's staged appearance patch. Apply persists that patch; cancel restores saved appearance. Date ranges are save-only.
params.previewId: Required for preview/apply/cancel: 1-80 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens. Reuse within one preview session, with a fresh retry key for each action. Omit for save.

commands.description: Start a Python or Pine strategy() backtest on captured closed candles. Returns preparing; poll get. Pine preserves its own fills, fees, quantity and equity without re-simulation; Python uses the shared signal engine. Requires local indicator/backtesting grant/retry key.

params.source: Python calculate source, or Pine strategy() source when language is pine, OR use a saved id.
params.id: Saved Python (py_) or Pine (pine_) source id instead of source.
params.parameters: Python only: validated JSON parameters, including bounded nested objects/arrays; _simulation is reserved. Optimization sweep candidates remain scalar.
params.strategyMode: Python: vectorized (default) or sequential. Pine: vectorized only.
params.config: Python only: optional capabilities.config fields. Pine uses its declaration and pineSettings.
params.range: Optional inclusive {from,to} epoch ms, null fetches latest closed source candles up to bars or source exhaustion, omitted uses chart selection. Apply pins this choice for reruns, including symbol/timeframe changes. Zoom never changes the tested period.
params.sessionSchedule: Optional user-assumption schedule for subsequent paper branches; does not synthesize backtest candles.
params.versionSuffix: Optional short version label appended to the run title (e.g. "aggressive" → "Name - aggressive") so different parameter variants stay distinguishable on the chart legend and in history.
params.inputs: Pine only: typed input values keyed by declared variable ID. Defaults come from the source or saved source inputs.
params.pineSettings: Pine only: explicit overrides {initial_capital,default_qty_type:fixed|cash|percent_of_equity,default_qty_value,commission_type:percent|cash_per_contract|cash_per_order,commission_value,slippage:integer ticks,pyramiding:0-100,margin_long:0-100,margin_short:0-100}. Omit to preserve strategy() defaults; no generic brackets or costs are added.

commands.description: Read status, accounting, pending orders, prefix-safe position analytics and paged ledger/equity/optimization. Analytics details: first 25 rows each with totals/truncation. Optional explicit regular-sampling assumptions enable annualized risk statistics. No source or raw candles.

params.section: trades|events|equity|optimization, default trades. Legacy research is accepted; both return section:research and the existing research summary, with top-level paged rows.
params.limit: 1-100, default 50; optimization pages use nextOffset until null.
params.risk: Optional explicit {samplesPerYear,expectedIntervalMs,riskFreeRateAnnual}; omitted means no annualization.

commands.description: Read a full owned local export in bounded JSON-text chunks, including pinned source/candles. Run must be stopped; keep expectedRevision fixed and concatenate text by offset.

params.expectedRevision: Current revision, fixed across all chunks.

commands.description: Request cancellation of an active backtest. Poll get for terminal status; partial results are not a completed run.
Create a fresh paper-replay branch from a completed backtest using identical frozen candles/settings. Starts flat by default; automatic strategy is explicit. Never live orders.
Start local forward PAPER from a completed backtest on its fresh live 1-240 minute chart. Seeds flat; manual by default, optional sequential Python. No broker orders.

params.sessionSchedule: Optional explicit {timeZone,weekdays:[ISO1-7],open:HH:mm,close:HH:mm,holidays:[YYYY-MM-DD],source:user-assumption,label?}. Omit inherits source-run defaults; null uses strict continuous intervals. Pinned for life of forward run.

commands.description: Stop a forward-paper clock without closing exposure or deleting orders. Never auto-resumes.
Explicitly resume paused forward paper on the original fresh live chart. Stale data/corrections/gaps block it. Missed contiguous candles require explicit catchUp.

params.catchUp: Optional boolean, default false; account for up to 100 missed contiguous closed candles.

commands.description: Advance historical replay. Manual practice fetches the next bounded page from its saved feed when captured candles run out, retaining the same account. Inspect paper.history for waiting/search limits. Backtest-derived replay remains frozen; automatic sequential mode steps exactly one. Forward paper advances only from its feed. No next candle means no fill.

Rewind manual practice replay to the state before its last Next/Play step: the candle, fills, orders and balance from that step and anything placed since are undone. Saved with the session (recent steps, bounded in size); unavailable after history is rolled or the interval changes.

Submit an entry/exit for MANUAL replay or running manual forward paper. Replay market orders fill at the current revealed close with costs; other orders and protection use later candles. Forward fills require a candle opening after the decision. Inspect orderExecution for filled/rejected immediate outcomes.

params.symbol: Optional captured paper-session instrument; defaults to the displayed instrument (pending orders infer their instrument).

commands.description: Cancel a pending paper order; filled orders cannot be cancelled. Forward cancellation is queued for candles opening after the decision; earlier terms remain effective.

params.symbol: Optional captured paper-session instrument; defaults to the displayed instrument (pending orders infer their instrument).

commands.description: Replace pending paper order terms atomically; invalid input preserves the original. Forward amendments are queued by decision time, never backdated into the forming candle.

params.order: Full replacement order, same fields as simulation.order.
params.symbol: Optional captured paper-session instrument; defaults to the displayed instrument (pending orders infer their instrument).

commands.description: Change paper position protection. Forward changes are queued for candles opening after the decision. No broker call; inspect pendingProtection for queued terms.

params.symbol: Optional captured paper-session instrument; defaults to the displayed instrument (pending orders infer their instrument).

commands.description: Explicit full/partial reduce-only close. params.all: Optional boolean: close every position in this replay account atomically at current closes. Cannot combine with symbol or quantity; stale markets reject the entire request.

commands.description: Restore the run's feed/symbol/interval, wait for native history, then focus its fills. Restores replay cutoff for replay runs; clears cutoff for batch. No provider fallback or removal of user drawings.

params.symbol: Optional captured paper-session instrument; defaults to the displayed instrument (pending orders infer their instrument).

commands.description: Detach this run's chart overlays only. Retains the run, trades, source and saved history; use show to add it again. Does not stop paper execution or alter replay time.
Open the displayed run's native in-chart settings dialog. Visibility, arrows, lines, labels and risk-level controls do not rerun or delete optimization.
Explicitly delete one local, non-running simulation; cloud layouts and Python sources remain unchanged.

Apply a Python or TLScript-Pine strategy to the chart like an indicator and immediately run it. Only one strategy applies at a time: every apply (edited source, new inputs/parameters or a different script) replaces the applied one in place, cancels any in-flight run of the old version and reruns, keeping the auto-rerun choice. It reruns on chart symbol/timeframe change (newest run wins). The Backtesting panel shows the latest live run; the previous result stays dimmed until the rerun settles.

params.grid: Up to 4 Python parameter keys or declared Pine input variable IDs with value arrays; Cartesian max12. Pine values must satisfy declared types, bounds and options; not strategy execution-setting overrides.
params.folds: Walk-forward 1-5. Total max72 evaluations /1000 sequential prefix callbacks.
params.objective: Optional netPnl (highest, default) or maxDrawdown (lowest); training-only; ties grid order. P&L includes open mark-to-market.
params.minCompletedPositions: Optional integer >=0 default0. Fully completed positions (Pine entry lots), not exit legs; checked on training only.
params.maxDrawdown: Optional nonnegative maximum training drawdown in account currency/units, NOT percent.

commands.description: After explicit confirmation, separately backtest an eligible selected candidate on the original FULL frozen sample, source, history and costs. params.researchId: Current completed research.id (response key retained); legacy reports without id must rerun optimization.
params.confirmed: Must be true after user confirms same-sample separate rerun.

Control native manual Bar Replay only; select opens the chart's notice and candle picker for user interaction. Other actions require an active native cursor, never paper replay. Requires local write approval and retry key. Inspect chart.getState.replay afterward.

Read a discovered study's input types, defaults, bounds and options.
Add a native study; no source execution/removals. Requires indicator grant and retry key. Verify chart.snapshot.

Toggle one exact built-in native study, never a managed script or drawing. Requires matching current visibility, indicator grant and retry key.

Read up to 50 authorized published report names and filter availability from the open Market Intelligence panel. Not streaming quotes.
Read at most 10 authorized published report rows with snapshot provenance. Requires the mounted panel and a dataset from intelligence.catalog; not live quotes or redistribution rights.
Read at most five published NSE participant summaries from the mounted Futures panel. Aggregate reports, not live positions or forecasts.

params.isIndex: Optional boolean, true for index futures (default), false for stock futures.

commands.description: Read current heatmap settings, aggregate breadth and quote receipt time from the open panel. No per-ticker quotes; receipt time is not provider freshness.
List this account's saved cloud chart alert rules (id, ticker, timeframe, status, direction, price/trendline, frequency, price source). Read-only; does not return live trigger state.

Create a horizontal latest-price alert on a symbol, monitored from shared cloud quotes while the signed-in Alerts panel is mounted. Trendline alerts must be drawn on the chart. Requires sign-in, local write permission and an idempotencyKey.

params.timeframe: Optional resolution for bar bucketing, e.g. 1, 15, 1D; default 1D
params.name: Optional label
params.expiresAt: Optional future ISO UTC; stops monitoring after

commands.description: Enable (resume) or disable (pause) a saved alert rule by id, using its latest saved version. Requires sign-in, write permission and an idempotencyKey.

params.enabled: Required boolean; true resumes, false pauses

commands.description: Edit a saved alert at its latest version. price: horizontal rules only. Needs write grant + idempotencyKey.

params.name: Optional

Discover chart feeds. Inspect discovery.status: failed broker discovery returns only default with an explicit error, never cached brokers. Chart feeds do not change the backend screening source.

Fetch historical OHLCV candles for a symbol/interval/window through the exact same feed path the chart uses. Pick the feed with feeds.list (default TradingLead/local adapters, or a connected broker like kite, fyers, web-dhan). Give the window as from+to, to+countBack, or just countBack. Returns up to 5000 bounded candles with epoch-millisecond UTC times; not a live/streaming quote and receipt time is not provider freshness. No feed is ever silently substituted.

params.feed: Feed id from feeds.list (e.g. default, kite, fyers, web-dhan).
params.symbol: Canonical ticker in the feed's format, e.g. NSE:RELIANCE-EQ.
params.resolution: Whole minutes 1-1440 (including 3,10,20,45,75,90), or 1D,1W,1M. Broker custom intervals require a compatible exact-divisor native base; no provider substitution.
params.from: Optional window start: YYYY-MM-DD or epoch seconds. Supply from and/or countBack.
params.to: Optional window end: YYYY-MM-DD or epoch seconds; defaults to now.
params.countBack: Optional number of candles ending at 'to' (1-5000). Supply from and/or countBack.

commands.description: List available stock categories or the symbols in one category.

params.category: Optional category identifier from this command.

commands.description: Discover supported backend screeners and their actual parameters before running a scan.
Start an authenticated, plan-limited cloud scan without changing the grid. Every run consumes account allowance and reads current stored data, not streaming quotes. Poll getResults.

params.tickers: 1-500 canonical tickers, subject to account limits
params.source: Optional: default only. Broker-backed scanning is not available.
params.refreshCache: Optional legacy boolean; current screening always reads fresh.

commands.description: Read an owned scan's status, results, evidence and source timestamps.

params.source: Nonempty Pine indicator source; no fixed character cap. Execution and transport limits still apply.
params.inputs: Optional declared Pine string, finite-number or boolean inputs, bounded to 8000 serialized characters.
params.plotIndex: Optional nonnegative safe integer selecting a real numeric plot, default 0. Available plots are discovered from execution, not compilation.

Cancel a local broker scan and its pending history request. Does not undo watchlist writes or broker quota already consumed.
List the signed-in user's TradingLead watchlists, not broker watchlists.

params.runId: Completed scan to save; supply runId OR symbols.

Read Studio's current source, parameters, dirty/compile state, selected instance and actual workspace visibility. An open mounted editor may still be hidden.

Open Studio and load exact saved or applied Pine/Python source, inputs and update target. Waits for mounting; refuses dirty drafts and unavailable/private source. Requires indicator grant and retry key; never runs source or changes chart instances.

Waits for mounting and preserves dirty edits. Requires indicator grant and retry key; never compiles, saves, applies or removes chart instances.

Read this authenticated account's purchased native indicator collection, independent of chart placement. Does not purchase, import source, or grant a license.

commands.description: Read this authenticated creator's native indicator sales and manual settlement status. Does not transfer money.

Publish a saved Pine indicator as a separate paid apply-only publication and register its fixed-term checkout. Requires verified seller approval, current saved revision, indicator grant and retry key. Does not charge a buyer or transfer money. Existing free shares cannot become paid.

params.visibility: link or public; public requires moderation.

commands.description: Delete an account library file at its current device revision and report cloud confirmation. Does not remove chart instances or revoke separately published shares. Requires indicator grant and a retry key.
Inspect this tab's Pine chart readiness and applied TLScript-Pine snapshots without source payloads. Does not fetch candles or certify data freshness.

Retry pending saved Pine chart instances using Studio's restore queue. Requires a registered chart, indicator grant and retry key. Acknowledges the request, not successful restoration; poll indicators.applied for history readiness, restorationStatus and restoreErrors. Does not change saved source or resolve layout conflicts.
